title: Rows, Columns, Tables
summary: Rows are facts at one grain. Columns name the attributes available for each row. Tables collect rows of the same kind, so a learner can reason about shape before syntax.
learning_objectives: Read ecommerce.products as a one-table row set.
Write or explain SQL using only Phase 1 concepts for rows, columns, tables.
reflection_prompts: Which row did your query include or exclude, and why?

references.why: PostgreSQL reference syntax for the small SQL forms used in this lesson.
